body.message: Dear Shahir, As we have received your request to receive the security deposit refund in cash, we have coordinated the arrangement with our Finance Department. You may visit our office on any weekday between  9:30 AM and 5:30 PM  to collect the refund in cash. Please note that the booking is registered under the name  Sheza Butt . Therefore, either the named guest must visit the office personally, or, if someone else will be collecting the refund on their behalf, the authorized person will need to present a copy of the guest’s Emirates ID or passport for verification. We kindly appreciate your cooperation and understanding. Kind regards, Tharushi Sha
